div.head: II As 20.1
div.ab: Gif he þonne ryht wyrcan nylle ne þa oferhyrnesse syllan, þonne ridan þa yldestan men to, ealle þe to þære byrig hiron, ⁊ nímon eall ðæt he age ⁊ setton hine on borh.
Gif he ðonne rihte wyrcan nylle ne ða oferhyrnysse syllan, ðonne riden ealle ða yldestan men, ðe to ðær byrig hyren, ⁊ nimen ealle þæt he age ⁊ setten hine on borh.
Gif he ðonne ryht wyrcan nelle ne þa oferhyrnesse sellan, ðonne riden e . . . þa yldstan men to, ðe to þære . . . hieren, ⁊ nimen . . . þæt he age ⁊ setten hine on borh.
Si (tunc etiam) rectum facere nolit nec oferhyrnessam (meam) dare, tunc eant seniores homines omnes, qui ad eam curiam obediunt, et capiant omne quod (quicquid) habet et mittant eum in plegium.
Gif he þonne ryht wyrcan nylle ne þa oferhyrnesse syllan, þonne ridan þa yldestan men to, ealle þe to þære byrig hiron, ⁊ nimon eall ðæt he age ⁊ setton hine on borh.

Wenn er [Verklagter] aber Rechtspflicht nicht erfüllen noch jenen ‘Ungehorsam’ büssen will, dann sollen alle die angesehensten Leute, welche zu jener Gerichtsstadt gehören [zu ihm] hinziehen und alles, was er hat, fortnehmen und ihn unter Bürgschaft stellen.

But if he [the accused] will neither fulfil his legal obligation nor pay that ‘disobedience’ [fine], then all the most senior men who belong to that court-town are to ride [to him] and take everything that he has and put him under surety.

If, however, he will not comply with the law, and pay the fine for insubordination, then all the chief men who belong to the borough shall ride [to his house] and take all that he owns, and place him under surety.
If, however, he will not do justice nor pay the fine for disobedience, the leading men are to ride thither, all who belong to the borough, and take all that he owns and put him under surety.

seniores (maiores natu 20, 4) nicht nach Alter, sondern sozialem Rang; s. Wb: eald 6, in Ann. Agsax. a. 915. 978. 1015; Urk. c. 1006 Ke 1302; Toller Suppl.: eald VIII. Sie sind hier wohl nicht technisch, amtlich begrenzt: sonst stände eine Zahl (XII) dabei. — Die Verteilung des Konfiszierten erhellt aus der Wiederholung des Satzes u. 20, 4

seniores (maiores natu 20, 4) not by age but by social rank; see Wb: eald 6, in Ann. Agsax. a. 915. 978. 1015; charter c. 1006 Ke 1302; Toller Suppl.: eald VIII. They are probably not technically or officially defined here: otherwise a number (XII) would be given. — The distribution of what is confiscated becomes clear from the repetition of the sentence below 20, 4
Bessere (auch 20, 4) ‘Gerichtstätte’; keineswegs ‘Burg’; s. Gl Gericht 4 g
Read (also in 20, 4) ‘court-place’; by no means ‘fortress’; see Gl Gericht 4 g

eant Q richtig; ‘reiten’ (auch Toller 781. 795) vielleicht zu eng (vgl. Wb: ridan 2), wenn auch die Mehrzahl der Vollstrecker laut VI 4 zu Pferde (s. d. Gl 11 a) war. Im selben Sinne faran VI As 7. II Cn 33. Neben ‘reiten, Ritt’ heisst rad, ridan, geridan: itio, profectio, ‘schaukeln, flattern [ahd. ‘sich bewegen’ allgemein], mit Gewalt überziehen, unterwerfen’. Weder weite Entfernung (die Maitland Dom. 185 nur aus dem Worte ridan folgert) noch Eiligkeit lag stets bei der Pfändung vor

eant Q correctly; ‘ride’ (also Toller 781. 795) perhaps too narrow (cf. Wb: ridan 2), even if most of the executors, according to VI 4, were on horseback (see that word in Gl 11 a). faran VI As 7. II Cn 33 is used in the same sense. Besides ‘ride, riding’, rad, ridan, geridan mean itio, profectio, ‘swing, flutter [OHG ‘move’ in general], overrun by force, subdue’. Neither great distance (which Maitland Dom. 185 infers solely from the word ridan) nor haste was always present in distraint
Vgl. Gl Vermögenseinziehung 10 o; Gerichtsversäumnis 3; Strafvollzug 4. Dass Kläger aus Konfisziertem befriedigt wird, sagen VI 1, 1. III Eg 7
Cf. Gl Vermögenseinziehung 10 o; Gerichtsversäumnis 3; Strafvollzug 4. That the plaintiff is satisfied out of what is confiscated is stated by VI 1, 1. III Eg 7
